reading_method: Authenticated Google Drive metadata and raw fetch (include_base64=false); sediment file reference materialized with download_file; original PDF rendered with PyMuPDF at 2x (144 dpi); every page inspected through view_image/model vision; enlarged 3x/4x PDF crops used for uncertain handwriting and diagram labels. Local PDF text extraction used alongside images for printed sheets only.
sync_rule: A file is current only if a remote per-file successful status (processed or skipped_non_study) matches its modified timestamp. Pending or absent records must be retried. Publish notes and this manifest in the same non-forced default-branch commit. Preserve manual edits.
duplicate_comparison: All four sources were inspected page by page. The two printed sheets have 2 pages each; the corresponding handwritten files have 9 and 15 pages, contain distinct answer material, and have separate Markdown destinations. No sources share a source-note destination.
